contact.basis: Christopher Street sidewalk at the commercial entrance of 53.

verticalDatum: USGS NY_CMPG_2013 one-metre DEM; provider catalog NAVD88. Model uses provider-relative elevation at the original Christopher Street sidewalk reference, without fitting heights to architecture.

sourceRaster.title: USGS one meter x58y451 NY CMPG 2013

attribution: USGS National Map 3D Elevation Program (3DEP), source-specific NY_CMPG_2013 one-metre DEM
method: Locked provider dataset30939, no visualization raster function; original F32 GeoTIFF retained. Pixel-centre bilinear sampling in the unchanged native frame, rounded to0.1mm. No flattening, offsets, building masks, pads or fitting. Original mapped footprints, street contact, host terrain-reference placement and model geometry retained.
limitations: The service resamples the selected one-metre bare-earth DEM. Pixel spacing does not establish surveyed accuracy or present paving/curb levels.
The acquisition/catalog dates identify the source project, not a current facade survey. Historical ground interpolation and later paving changes remain uncertain.
Only a host using compatible provider-relative ground is demonstrated; other host terrain datasets may differ.
